scripts.build: node scripts/bump-version.js && node scripts/build-images.js && node scripts/extract-agent-constants.js && terser src/js/script-v2.js -o script-v2.js -c passes=2 -m && terser src/js/admin.js -o admin.js -c passes=2 -m && terser src/js/tracking.js -o tracking.js -c -m && terser src/js/agent-chat.js -o agent-chat.js -c passes=2 -m && cleancss -o style.css src/css/style.css
scripts.dev: node scripts/bump-version.js && node scripts/extract-agent-constants.js && node -e "[['src/js/admin.js','admin.js'],['src/js/script-v2.js','script-v2.js'],['src/css/style.css','style.css'],['src/js/tracking.js','tracking.js'],['src/js/agent-chat.js','agent-chat.js']].forEach(([s,d])=>{require('fs').copyFileSync(s,d);console.log('copied',s,'->', d)})"
